title: TRIZ principle 6 — universality
problem_statement: Single-function objects multiply inventory and cost. The problem is documented and scoped before any solution work begins.
concept: One object performs multiple functions: smartphone, Swiss army knife, sofa-bed. Universality cuts count and cost. Constraint emphasis: the listed constraints are the design drivers — solve the hardest one first.
novelty_assessment: The multi-tool principle, stated as method.
constraints: Jack of all trades, master of none
validation_plan: Count functions per object in your system; target the singles
Document the outcome honestly whether it confirms or kills the concept.
